feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: From Maine to Michigan, progressive candidates scored big wins for the Democratic Party
entry.summary: In states like Maine and Michigan, Progressives delivered major wins that helped return Democrats to power in Washington. NPR's Elena Moore discusses what comes next.

entry.title: Voters rejected Trump in the midterm elections. What's next for the GOP?
entry.summary: President Trump asked for voters to act like he was on the ballot. If they took that advice voters gave him a stinging repudiation of his record.

entry.title: Kansas just elected a Democrat. His message to Washington? Be decent
entry.summary: The Methodist pastor who flipped a Republican Senate seat says voters want more than political change. He tells NPR what he heard from Kansans about decency, faith and finding common ground.

entry.title: What we know about California election results
entry.summary: Though lots of votes are left to count in California, some results in important races and ballot measures are already in.

entry.title: Hasan Piker discusses results in the midterm elections he campaigned for
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with prominent left-wing Twitch streamer and commentator Hasan Piker about preliminary results of the midterm elections.

entry.title: Trump reacts to midterm election results
entry.summary: President Trump made the 2026 midterms all about him - and the Iran war and economic undertow took their toll.

entry.title: The Democrats won big in the midterm elections. What's next?
entry.summary: University of Virginia's Center for Politics director Larry Sabato talks about what's next for the Democratic Party after their resounding win Tuesday night.

entry.title: Abdul El-Sayed welcomes Trump's plan to cut Israel aid, calls for end to arms sales
entry.summary: Michigan's first Muslim senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed, discusses his historic victory, an unlikely agreement with Trump on Israel military aid and the political divisions that remain.

entry.title: Democrat Amy Acton defeats Vivek Ramaswamy in race to become Ohio's next governor
entry.summary: Democrat Amy Acton, Ohio's former health director, will be the state's next governor. Her win marks the first time in two decades that Ohioans have elected a Democrat to lead the state.

entry.title: What issues mattered to Independent voters this election cycle
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to political consultant and publisher of The Bulwark, Sarah Longwell, who runs focus groups with swing voters, about what mattered to independents in the midterms.
